caption: The drawing features a rectangular textile-like object with a deep red background, bordered at the bottom by a wide horizontal band of darker purple. Across the center, a detailed arrangement of flowers and leaves is depicted. The flowers are light cream or white in color with yellow centers, and have multiple layered petals. The leaves are a mix of green and brown shades, with some curling and some pointed, attached to thin, winding, curly vines painted in yellowish tones. There are also a few unopened flower buds colored in shades of green and yellow. Along the top edge, there is an illustrated gray and white trim suggesting a hanging rod or support. The composition is balanced vertically, with the floral design concentrated towards the left and middle, leaving some of the red background visible on the right. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Embroidered Banner
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
